principle: Source labels are screening hints only. A base intent enters the selected set only after an explicit row-level review against the frozen C1-C8 definition.
eligibility_rule: The text is a concrete harmful request or behavior, not a benign or defensive discussion.
A reviewer assigns exactly one primary C1-C8 category based on the text and records a short rationale; mixed or unclear cases are excluded.
The source label is recorded but never overrides the text-level judgment.
Duplicate or near-duplicate underlying intents are retained at most once across sources.
Severity is reviewed separately after selection and is never inferred from source category.
